blocked.private-one-shard-round-trip: Requires a running SDK3 aggregator and the paired node lane. The native tier executes the real vault, verifier, registry and B1/B2 natives in-process only.
blocked.real-chain-lock-backing: The lock backing inside the oracle histories is the oracle's synthetic EVM state proof, not an eth_getProof of the vault state the native tier executed.
blocked.paired-restart-reorg: Requires the same joined deployment; wallet recovery, synthetic proof refresh and in-process execution do not establish chain restart/reorg safety.
blocked.native-budget-benchmarks: Per-call native and transaction gas are measured in-process (native-report.json); production activation budgets, arm64 CPU, block/system-gas interaction and final deployment pins remain open.
